messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1 1 want to lock microtiming for the marketplace launch next Thu. Proposal: landing cutover 09:00 PT, press release 09:05 PT, blog 09:15 PT, partner emails 09:30 PT. Any objections?
Liam: fine. prefer press at :05 to give embargo buffer. can ops delay heavy catalog ingestion by +10m?
Noah: yes 1 we can throttle non-critical ingestion. core tenant provisioning must be live at 09:00.
Ava: marketing ready for 09:05 press. request a 5m heads-up from infra before cutover to queue social posts. @Priya can you send it?
Priya: I will. Marta, can you confirm ApexEdge hero size + dark-mode asset?
Marta: ApexEdge confirmed hero 1200x400 and provided dark-mode PNG. uploading to /assets/partners/apexedge now. listing id mkp-APX-2025.
Priya: noted. SI partners IntegralSI & AtlasWorks need pre-warm access. @Noah can you provision service accounts and smoke endpoints?
Noah: provisioning done. smoke endpoints & creds available by 08:20 PT. I'll run KV-cache warm sweep at 08:30.
Ava: blog draft plan: short lead, 3 partner callouts, technical sidebar on latency gains. need final by EOD for review.
Liam: press copy: avoid customer names unless legal signs off. legal has been pinged; fallback to product quote if no approval.
Priya: ops: set temporary throughput cap first 30m to avoid noisy neighbors. Noah, recommend 120% baseline cap?
Noah: 120% baseline sounds safe. I'll set autoscale guardrails and monitor.
Marta: hardware monitoring will post telemetry to partner portal webhook. confirm webhook live?
Noah: webhook endpoint live; auth token rotated this morning.
Priya: deploy-bot, create temporary channel topic and pin the runbook at cutover please.
deploy-bot: Created channel topic and pinned runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-launch-microtiming
calendar-bot: Reminder set: "Marketplace launch microtiming - final preflight" 08:00 PT Thu.
Priya: adding three canned CS responses to runbook for pricing, onboarding timeline, and data residency Qs. Ava, can you stitch them into the support section?
Ava: on it. also add "what to say" bullets so CS doesn't improvise.
Liam: PR targeting: tech outlets 09:05, general biz 09:20. I'll stagger the embargo list accordingly.
Marta: HW partners will standby at 09:00 to swap hero if needed.
Priya: final checklist: 
```
- 08:00 PT preflight (all teams) - confirm smoke ✅
- 08:20 PT SI endpoints ready ✅
- 08:30 PT KV warm sweep ✅
- 09:00 PT landing cutover (16:00 UTC) ✅
- 09:05 PT press release publish ✅
- 09:10 PT social go (5m after press) ✅
- 09:15 PT blog publish ✅
- 09:30 PT partner outbound email ✅
```
Priya: react :thumbsup: when aligned or flag blockers now.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Noah: :thumbsup:
Ava: :thumbsup:
Marta: :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks all 1 I'll post the minute-by-minute runbook here 1h before launch.
